mapper.select: select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, /**业务类型Code**/ d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, /**业务类型**/ acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarketCode,/**交易场所Code**/ d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ d.INV_AIM as invAimCode,/**投资目的Code**/ d.INV_AIM as invAim,/**投资目的**/ to_char(d.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as tradeDate,/**发生日 - 取交易日期**/ d.CCY as ccyCode,/**币种Code**/ d.CCY as ccy,/**币种**/ d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt,/**交易本金**/ d.INT_AMT as intAmt,/**交易利息**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt,/**交易金额**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, /**交易状态Code**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus /**交易状态**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
